|translation='''Title:''' Snowstorm.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy at the outermost marker. All characters at the same exterior location are missing. Each turn, during your control phase, the storm moves to the next marker. If it reaches the innermost marker, it reverses direction. The Mobile Effect is lost if it moves beyond the outermost marker.

'''Lore:'''
Hoth snowstorms move fast and take erratic paths, so they sometimes cause serious damage.
